title: ADVANCED OPTIMIZATION
description: Required for all undergraduate students majoring in IE, OR:EMS, OR:FE, and OR. This is a follow-up to IEOR E3608 and will cover advanced topics in optimization, including integer optimization, convex optimization, and optimization under uncertainty, with a strong focus on modeling, formulations, and applications
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( IEOR E3608 ) IEOR E3608 For undergraduates only.
